footprints.description: D2PAK (TO-263AB), 2 leads + tab, Vishay drawing, 9.08 x 10.16 mm body
footprints.note: Vishay D2PAK outline 95046 pad layout (R1; tab pad 11.00 min x 9.65 min, lead pads 2.32 min x 3.81 min at +-2.54 (e 2.54 BSC; drawn 2.41-2.64 mid 2.525), overall 16.45 mid (15.00-17.90 mm; the inch values 0.625-0.70 do not match)), vishay/vs-20cth03shm3.pdf p.6 (same drawing in vishay/vs-16ctqs-m3series.pdf p.6); turned 90 deg CW (leads left, tab right); pattern centred on its overall extent, body D 9.08 mid (8.51-9.65) x E 10.16 mid (9.65-10.67) on the same centre. Pins: datasheet lead 1 = 1, lead 3 = 2, base/tab (2, 4) = 3 (tab last); cut lead 2 has no pad

footprints.description: FlatPAK 5x6 dual-pad, Vishay drawing, 6.2 x 5.15 mm body, 1.27 mm pitch
footprints.note: Vishay FlatPAK 5 x 6 PCB footprint (dual pad) (R1; 4X 0.75 x 1.00 lead pads at 1.27 pitch, two big pads 2.08 wide (4.56 over both, 0.40 apart) x 4.84 high, widened to 5.55 over both for their inner 1.40, 0.75 gap to the lead pads, 6.59 overall), vishay/v10km120du.pdf p.4 (same numbers in vishay/v10k100du.pdf, vishay/v6k100du.pdf); top view turned 90 deg CW so pins 1-4 form the left column. The two big pads take leads 5-6 and 7-8 (exposed pads that are terminals, numbered last): pad 5 = the pad under leads 5, 6; pad 6 = the pad under leads 7, 8; each drawn as a 2.08 x 4.84 core plus its 0.494 x 1.40 widening (0.495 per the drawing, cut to 0.494 so pad centres stay on 0.001 mm); the 0.56-deep notch in each big pad (width not given) is not drawn. Body E 6.20 nom x D 5.15 nom. Pattern centred on the body

footprints.description: TO-220AB / TO-220 FullPAK 3-lead, Vishay drawing, 10.1 x 4.57 mm body, 2.54 mm pitch
footprints.note: Vishay TO-220AB package outline (R5; lead 0.80 mid (0.70-0.90) -> drill 1.05, pad 1.75; pitch 2.54 = pins 1-3 5.075 mid (4.95-5.20) / 2, the 2.45-2.65 pin-pitch dimension mids at 2.55), vishay/v30100ci.pdf p.4; same land pattern from Vishay 3L TO-220 FullPAK outline (2.54 TYP, lead 0.7-0.9), vishay/vs-20cth03fp.pdf p.5, whose body is 10.3 x 4.7. Body 10.10 mid (9.65-10.54) x 4.57 mid (4.44-4.70); leads 1-2-3 left to right in the front view; the tab is not a land; pads on the body centre line. Not footprints-B.json TO-220-3-VISHAY: B sizes its hole from the VS drawing's 1.01 max lead (drill 1.30, pad 2.0)

footprints.description: DFN8 5x6 dual flag (SO8FL-Dual), onsemi drawing, 6.15 x 5.15 mm body, 1.27 mm pitch
footprints.note: onsemi DFN8 5x6 1.27P Dual Flag CASE 506BT issue F soldering footprint (R1; 4X 0.75 x 1.00 lead pads at 1.27 pitch, big pads 2.08 wide (4.56 over both) x 4.84 high with two 1.40-high lobes each widening them to 5.55 over both, lobe centres 2.30 apart, the lower lobe flush with the pad bottom, upper lobe top 3.70 above it; 6.59 overall (the drawing also gives a 0.70 gap, 0.05 short of 6.59; the 6.59 is kept)), onsemi/nhp620mfd-d.pdf p.5; top view turned 90 deg CW so pins 1-4 form the left column. The two big pads take leads 5-6 and 7-8 (exposed pads that are terminals, numbered last): pad 5 = the pad under leads 5, 6 (C2); pad 6 = the pad under leads 7, 8 (C1); each drawn as a 2.08 x 4.84 core plus its two 0.494 x 1.40 lobes (0.495 per the drawing, cut to 0.494 so pad centres stay on 0.001 mm); the 0.56-deep notches are not drawn. Body E 6.15 BSC x D 5.15 BSC
